label: Onboarding Checklist
description: A product's 'get started' checklist, stuck part way: the STALLED NEW USER. A card with the title, 'n of N complete', a progress bar and the tasks (done ones with a filled green check, the first open one marked with 'Continue ->'), plus an optional plain idle line under the card ('LAST ACTIVE 3 DAYS AGO'). Script it with `complete`: a task's circle fills with a pop, the bar and count step up and the marker moves on -- the nudge worked. The onboarding beat of a lifecycle or automation film. 1440-wide design stage at the box's aspect, scaled to the box.

idle.label: Plain line under the card (uppercase grey type, no box)

complete.label: Tasks ticked off during the scene

still.label: The card is there from the first frame
